overview: Full K3s cluster bootstrap for Server A: K3s, Traefik, optional Authelia SSO, optional Argo CD, and Kubernetes Dashboard. HTTPS at auth.*, acd.*, dash.*, and traefik.*. Authelia ForwardAuth protects all admin web UIs in production.
prerequisites: Domain name (e.g. srv1.example.com) with DNS you control
Ports 80 and 443 open to the internet for HTTPS
Port 6443 restricted to your admin IP (use himosoft-firewall)
DNS A record for auth.* if using Authelia (default auth.your-domain)

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-k3s-server

steps.title: Run interactive setup
steps.body: Prompts for public IP, domain, Authelia admin user/password (with confirmation), account email label (not sent anywhere), hostnames, Let's Encrypt email, and optional Argo CD. Login is password-only — no SMTP or TOTP setup needed.

steps.title: Point DNS
steps.body: A records to your public IP: auth.*, acd.*, dash.*, traefik.*
steps.command:
# auth.srv1.example.com -> YOUR_PUBLIC_IP
# acd.srv1.example.com   -> YOUR_PUBLIC_IP
# dash.srv1.example.com  -> YOUR_PUBLIC_IP
# traefik.srv1.example.com -> YOUR_PUBLIC_IP

steps.title: Enable Let's Encrypt (after DNS)
steps.body: Re-run bootstrap — it detects DNS and upgrades Traefik to Let's Encrypt automatically.

steps.title: Login flow
steps.body: Open any protected URL → redirected to Authelia → login → access the UI. Argo CD and Dashboard still use their own credentials after Authelia.

commands.description: Platform only — skips installed components, enables SSL when DNS ready
Authelia user, Argo CD password, dashboard token

notes: Running with no arguments shows help — setup starts only with install
apt install does not run setup automatically
First install requires accepting Himosoft Terms (https://himosoft.com.bd/terms) and Privacy (https://himosoft.com.bd/privacy)
Login is password-only (one_factor) — no TOTP or mail server required
Re-running install or bootstrap skips components that are already installed
Reconfigure prompts appear only when hostnames or settings change
Authelia account email is metadata only; notifications use filesystem, not SMTP
Read Authelia codes: sudo k3s kubectl exec -n authelia deploy/authelia -- cat /data/notification.txt
Session cookie works across all subdomains of your base domain
Argo CD still requires its own admin password after Authelia login
Kubernetes Dashboard still requires token after Authelia login
